description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join the founding engineering team at an AI-powered commercial insurance company. You will work directly with the founder to build core AI systems that streamline how businesses find and obtain insurance coverage.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build browser-use agents that automate insurance workflows.

 - Develop voice AI for conversations with clients and insurance carriers.

 - Create long-horizon LLM pipelines and robust evaluation frameworks.

 - Build carrier integrations and AI-powered quoting and submission workflows.

 - Develop agents for policy analysis and insurance document processing.

 - Own systems end-to-end, contributing across a broad range of technical work.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Zero to five years of software engineering experience, including recent graduates.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including systems design, clean code, and debugging.

 - Hands-on experience building production LLM, AI agent, or voice AI systems, ideally including evaluation frameworks.

 - Experience with Python or TypeScript, and familiarity with LangGraph, AWS, browser-use agents, or autonomous agent frameworks.

 - Ability to build end-to-end systems in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - A CS or engineering degree and experience in a technical engineering role at a technology company or as a founding engineer.

 - Background in insurtech, fintech, or healthcare technology, or contributions to AI/ML open-source projects, is beneficial.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $150,000 to $235,000 annually, depending on experience, with meaningful founding-team equity. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
